items.markdown:
Ginger ale may offer mild relief for an upset stomach or nausea during a hangover, though it will not cure the hangover itself . Most users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF11GZX3AUot7QPh0vNfm9Lo4Qc1CQ4Gi0xZbZ5o49gLTSasyCCKEP5OIRWAXdjVq5k3eTcu0zMxB5E8o573SGQo3ag87P6eTU0bQ612Bf8lhgbLk467RM0L93v9RIKB5sZHhkyPoAejqg6tNk_CE-pd-DPRWVG_CQRzc3cVSxbB_TYedagUj-PoYtq8GQ) agree that ginger and carbonation can help settle a queasy stomach, while adding fluids like Pedialyte supports hydration.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXX29Vm59dWFG3yyVX83Q0mwdo4F58OtoU6QZSyEGGhUPXbZ7uLbQa1hhJ8n205zAK8DSA6eFMf6jMuHEWAGv1fJURvnwgDFj7tXS4xwMvHgCDZ1s7wlB5D0Y3FSLWUaRE_63EUOxAWsS8wOYrWvE8sg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXnRxoGgbMQZaa_PN2j5_LBTkYLNmMJFkUFGnqmKmDvBoJlB5v8ng9nlSsqSWE806LoAaNOz9Yz3U7namF83P6JycZA1_OIlGWga5vGc_mb0QiBPSjqSHpGYJJUovqM3EIFmo342Sr8kjzkun19LMb084C9Q)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF11GZX3AUot7QPh0vNfm9Lo4Qc1CQ4Gi0xZbZ5o49gLTSasyCCKEP5OIRWAXdjVq5k3eTcu0zMxB5E8o573SGQo3ag87P6eTU0bQ612Bf8lhgbLk467RM0L93v9RIKB5sZHhkyPoAejqg6tNk_CE-pd-DPRWVG_CQRzc3cVSxbB_TYedagUj-PoYtq8GQ)

### Potential Benefits

- **Stomach soothing:** Ginger can help ease nausea.
- **Fluid intake:** Drinking liquids helps address mild dehydration from alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESowEBxCJF10ee8baMSgniRZWAko27cMLGDNdqM8fTZFdfn5TdqE97RV9ijf74GhJMqP5hgOW_kr5jeXuKI-s_IkakY9TASB7ijQ3YnwDbvs7xrFiB-NrVktzxKvQ2KOyAeiroaUppkBb7roDIysAP6I5_zL0cGJPAaC4Lnj_OqL-z2xKqijiQyjka1q6wkIbUp2uvoevAFq1FaQPntj6jdU9p2J-q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXX29Vm59dWFG3yyVX83Q0mwdo4F58OtoU6QZSyEGGhUPXbZ7uLbQa1hhJ8n205zAK8DSA6eFMf6jMuHEWAGv1fJURvnwgDFj7tXS4xwMvHgCDZ1s7wlB5D0Y3FSLWUaRE_63EUOxAWsS8wOYrWvE8sg)

### Drawbacks to Watch For

- **Little real ginger:** Many commercial ginger ales rely on artificial flavorings rather than real ginger root.
- **High sugar:** Added sugars can worsen how you feel.
- **Carbonation:** Bubbles may cause gas or bloating in an already irritated stomach.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXEoKTVnhN7v-VwsJLKMwNAaf99OXj3LDm-TeQzIAvekZyb8ZNvVYV60j14H3y-pWHr8e98EakTc02KVnuBDL_zNs1fX4ft3lWdXN3MDe32kQDKCtUsIA59EvIPMY5dgSzi6HsATfHmaFNT_o-kUIkAP8PsUsN)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF11GZX3AUot7QPh0vNfm9Lo4Qc1CQ4Gi0xZbZ5o49gLTSasyCCKEP5OIRWAXdjVq5k3eTcu0zMxB5E8o573SGQo3ag87P6eTU0bQ612Bf8lhgbLk467RM0L93v9RIKB5sZHhkyPoAejqg6tNk_CE-pd-DPRWVG_CQRzc3cVSxbB_TYedagUj-PoYtq8GQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXX29Vm59dWFG3yyVX83Q0mwdo4F58OtoU6QZSyEGGhUPXbZ7uLbQa1hhJ8n205zAK8DSA6eFMf6jMuHEWAGv1fJURvnwgDFj7tXS4xwMvHgCDZ1s7wlB5D0Y3FSLWUaRE_63EUOxAWsS8wOYrWvE8sg)

### Better Alternatives
According to [Cleveland Clinic](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXX29Vm59dWFG3yyVX83Q0mwdo4F58OtoU6QZSyEGGhUPXbZ7uLbQa1hhJ8n205zAK8DSA6eFMf6jMuHEWAGv1fJURvnwgDFj7tXS4xwMvHgCDZ1s7wlB5D0Y3FSLWUaRE_63EUOxAWsS8wOYrWvE8sg) , ginger tea, ginger chews, or fresh ginger are often better choices for nausea than sugary sodas. Plain water, electrolyte drinks, rest, and time remain the main ways to recover as your body clears alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXnRxoGgbMQZaa_PN2j5_LBTkYLNmMJFkUFGnqmKmDvBoJlB5v8ng9nlSsqSWE806LoAaNOz9Yz3U7namF83P6JycZA1_OIlGWga5vGc_mb0QiBPSjqSHpGYJJUovqM3EIFmo342Sr8kjzkun19LMb084C9Q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXX29Vm59dWFG3yyVX83Q0mwdo4F58OtoU6QZSyEGGhUPXbZ7uLbQa1hhJ8n205zAK8DSA6eFMf6jMuHEWAGv1fJURvnwgDFj7tXS4xwMvHgCDZ1s7wlB5D0Y3FSLWUaRE_63EUOxAWsS8wOYrWvE8sg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXEoKTVnhN7v-VwsJLKMwNAaf99OXj3LDm-TeQzIAvekZyb8ZNvVYV60j14H3y-pWHr8e98EakTc02KVnuBDL_zNs1fX4ft3lWdXN3MDe32kQDKCtUsIA59EvIPMY5dgSzi6HsATfHmaFNT_o-kUIkAP8PsUsN)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXllAcAZrPqXOs4aa1ExAPyO39CFWjP4L73FUecH77Tb5-YSGZwdfH6z9V9YPFe2He0F_r8-6Rl4IbP3LcZPekOpO2HZ6oZp9_AVzYy8-QxtWWnOQKJ7e6ZY64X5_URMm9J5JA1pZdvw)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESowEBxCJF10ee8baMSgniRZWAko27cMLGDNdqM8fTZFdfn5TdqE97RV9ijf74GhJMqP5hgOW_kr5jeXuKI-s_IkakY9TASB7ijQ3YnwDbvs7xrFiB-NrVktzxKvQ2KOyAeiroaUppkBb7roDIysAP6I5_zL0cGJPAaC4Lnj_OqL-z2xKqijiQyjka1q6wkIbUp2uvoevAFq1FaQPntj6jdU9p2J-q)If you're dealing with a hangover right now, let me know what **symptoms** are bothering you most or if you're looking for **hydration and food** options.
